title: 第9章 金风野店第10章 法尔霍庄
content_zh:
苏亦川技艺得自名门真传，虽危不乱，激斗之中，忽骈左手两指，直向冯国栋乳下穴道点去。冯国栋急退两步。苏亦川两指变掌，在拉赫蒙脸前虚显一下，待对方举刀挡格，手掌故意迟迟缩回。拉赫蒙看出有便宜可占，鬼头刀变守为攻，直削过去。苏亦川左掌将敌人武器诱过，金笛横击，正中敌腰。拉赫蒙大哼一声，痛得蹲了下去。苏亦川待要赶打，冯国栋迎剑架住。冯辉一阵弹子，又把他挡住。
拉赫蒙顺了一口气，强忍痛楚，咬紧牙关，站起来溜到苏亦川背后，乘他前顾长剑、侧避弹子之际，用**生之力，鬼头刀使一招“独劈华山”向他后脑砍去，这招攻其无备，实难躲避。哪知刀锋堪堪砍到敌人顶心，腕上突然奇痛，武器拿捏不住，跌落在地，呆得一呆，胸口又中了一柄飞刀，当场气绝。
苏亦川回过头来，只见王怡丹左手扶桌，站在身后，右手拿着一柄飞刀，纤指执白刃，如持鲜花枝，俊目流眄，樱唇含笑，举手毙敌，浑若无事，说不尽的妩媚可喜。他一见之下，胸口一热，精神大振，金笛舞起一团黄光，大叫：“丹姊，把打弹弓的鹰爪子废了！”
王怡丹微微一笑，飞刀出手。冯辉听到叫声，忙转身迎敌，只见明晃晃的一把柳叶尖刀已迎胸飞来，风劲势急，忙举弹弓挡架，啪的一声，弓脊立断，飞刀余势未衰，又将他手背削破。冯辉大骇，狂叫：“师叔，风紧扯呼！”转身就走，冯国栋唰唰两剑，把苏亦川逼退两步，将软倒在地的金诺维奇背起，冯辉挥鞭断后，冲向店门。
苏亦川见警官逃走，也不追赶，将金笛举到嘴边。崔莹心想这人真是好整以暇，这当口还吹笛呢。谁知他这次并非横吹，而是像吹洞箫般直吹，只见他一鼓气，一支小箭从金笛中飞出来。冯辉头一低，小箭钉在金诺维奇臀上，痛得他哇哇大叫。
苏亦川转身问：“雷哥呢？”王怡丹说：“跟我来。”她腿上受伤，撑了根拖把当拐杖，引路进房。苏亦川从地下拾起一把飞刀交还王怡丹，问道：“丹姊怎么受的伤，不碍事么？”
那边冯国栋背了金诺维奇蹿出，生怕敌人追来，使足了劲往店门奔去，刚出门口，外面进来一人，登时撞个满怀。冯国栋数十年功夫，下盘扎得坚实异常，哪知被进来这人轻轻一碰，竟收不住脚，连连退出几步，把金诺维奇脱手抛在地上，才没跌倒。
这下金诺维奇可惨了，那支小箭在地上一撞，连箭羽没入肉里。
冯国栋一抬头，见进来的是蔡锦昂，转怒为喜，将已到嘴边的一句粗话缩回肚里，忙请了个安，说道：“蔡处长，我们不中用，一个兄弟让点子废了，这个又给点了穴道。”蔡锦昂哦了一声，左手一把将金诺维奇提起，右手在他腰里一捏，腿上一拍，就把他闭住的血脉解开了，问道：“点子跑了吗？”冯国栋说：“还在店里呢。”蔡锦昂“哼”了声说：“胆子倒不小，袭警拒捕，还敢大模大样地住店。”一边说话，一边走进院子。
冯辉一指雷盖的店房，说道：“蔡处长，点子在那里！”手持软鞭，当先开路。
一行人正要闯进，忽然左厢房中蹿出一个少女，手持红布背包，向蔡锦昂一扬，笑着说：“喂，又给我抢来啦！”说话间已奔到门边。蔡锦昂一怔，心想：“万澜物流的人真够脓包。我夺了回来，又被人家抢了去。别理她，自己正事要紧！”当下并不追赶，转身又要进房。那少女见他不追，停步叫道：“不知哪里偷学来几手三脚猫，还冒充是人家师叔呢，羞也不羞？”这少女正是崔莹。
蔡锦昂名震江湖，江湖人称八臂无常，与万澜物流集团老总厉士玉并称“江湖厉总、公门蔡统”。这些年来，他虽然热衷名利，身在**，武林人物见了他仍是敬畏有加，他几时受过这等奚落？当时气往上冲，一个箭步，举手向崔莹抓来，有心要把她抓到，好好教训一顿，再交给大师兄发落。他认定崔莹是高晓科的徒弟了。
崔莹见他追来，拔脚就逃。蔡锦昂说：“小妮子，往哪里逃！”追了几步，眼见她逃得极快，不想跟她纠缠，转身要办正事。哪知崔莹见他不追，又停步讥讽，说他浪得虚名，丢了清华派的脸，口中说话，脚下却丝毫不敢停留。蔡锦昂大怒，直追出两三里，其实大雨未停，两人身上全湿了。
蔡锦昂一发狠劲，暗想：“抓到你再说。”施展轻功，全力追来。他既决心要追，崔莹可就难以逃走了，眼见对方越追越近，知他武功卓绝，不禁发慌，斜刺里往山坡上奔去，蔡锦昂一声不响，随后跟来，脚步加快，已到崔莹背后，一伸手，抓住她背心衣服。崔莹大惊，用力一挣，嗤的一声，背上一块衣衫给扯了下来，心中突突乱跳。随手把红布背包往山涧里一抛，说道：“给你吧！”
蔡锦昂知道包里物件关系非小，**看得极重，被涧水一冲，不知流向何处，就算找得回来也必浸坏，当下顾不得追人，跃下山涧去拾背包。崔莹哈哈一笑，回身走了。
蔡锦昂拾起背包，见已湿了，忙打开要看是否浸湿，一解开，不由破口大骂，包里哪有什么神功秘籍？竟是客栈前台上的两本账簿。他大叹晦气，江湖上什么大阵大仗全见过，却连上了这小妮子两次大当，随手把账簿抛入山涧。
他好不烦躁，赶回客栈，一踏进门就遇见佟飞，见他背上好好的背着那红布背包，暗叫惭愧，忙问：“这背包有人动过没有？”佟飞说：“没有啊。”佟飞为人细心，知道蔡处长相问必有缘故，邀他同进店房，打开背包，只见神功秘籍好端端在内。蔡锦昂心中一松，问道：“冯国栋他们哪里去了？”佟飞说：“刚才还见到在这里。”
蔡锦昂生气说：“国家养了这帮人有屁用！我只走开几步，就远远躲了起来。佟老弟，你跟我来，你瞧我单枪匹马，将这点子抓了。”说着便向雷盖所住店房走去。佟飞心下为难，他慑于协力社的威名，知道这社团人多势众，高手如云，自己可惹他们不起。但蔡锦昂的话却也不敢违拗，当下抱定宗旨袖手旁观，决不参与。好在蔡锦昂武功卓绝，对方三人中倒有两个受伤，势必手到擒来，他说过要单枪匹马，就让他单枪匹马上阵便是。
蔡锦昂走到门外，大喝一声：“协匪们，给我滚出来！”
隔了半晌，房内毫无声息。他哼了声说：“没种！”抬腿踢门，房门虚掩，并未上锁，竟然不见有人。他一惊，叫道：“点子跑啦！”冲进房去，房里空空如也，床上棉被隆起，似乎被内有人，拔剑挑开棉被，果有两人相向而卧，他以剑尖在朝里那人背上轻刺一下，那人动也不动，扳过来看时，那人脸上毫无血色，两眼突出，竟是警官金诺维奇，脸朝外的人则是维京来的冯辉，伸手一探鼻息，两人均已气绝。这两人身上并无血迹，也无刀剑伤口，再加细查，见两人后脑骨都碎成细片，乃内家高手掌力所击，不禁对雷盖暗暗佩服，心想他重伤之余，还能使出如此厉害内力。可是冯国栋去了何处？雷盖夫妇又逃往何方？把前台叫来细问，竟无半点头绪。

蔡锦昂这下可没猜对，金诺维奇与冯辉并不是雷盖打死的。
原来当时杜静芳与崔莹隔窗观战，见苏亦川遇险，杜静芳暗发芙蓉金针，打中拉赫蒙手腕，鬼头刀落地，王怡丹赶来送上一把飞刀把他打死。冯国栋背起金诺维奇逃走。杜静芳放下了心，以为王怡丹和苏亦川二人难关已过，哪知蔡锦昂却闯了进来。
崔莹说：“昨晚抢我背包的就是他。老师认得他吗？”杜静芳嗯了一声，心下计算已定，低声说：“你去把他引开，越远越好。回来如不见我，明天你们自管上路，我随后赶来。”崔莹还待要问，杜静芳说：“快去！迟了怕来不及。可得千万小心。”她知道这个女学生聪明伶俐，而且她父亲是在职军官，就算被蔡锦昂捉到，也不敢难为她。又知蔡锦昂心高气傲，不屑和妇孺动手，果然不出所算。但其实蔡锦昂如发暗器，或施杀手，崔莹也早受伤，只因以为她是大师兄之徒，手下留了情，这倒非杜静芳始料之所及。
杜静芳见蔡锦昂追出店门，微一凝思，提笔匆匆写了封信，放在怀内，走到雷盖房门外，在门上轻敲两下。房里一个女人声音问：“谁呀？”杜静芳说：“我是王金童先生的好朋友，有要事奉告。”里面并不答话，也不开门，当是在商量如何应付。这时冯国栋三人却慢慢走近，远远站着监视，见杜静芳站在门外，很是诧异。
房门打开，苏亦川站在门口，斯斯文文问：“是哪位前辈？”杜静芳低声说：“我是你师姑杜静芳。”苏亦川脸现迟疑，他确知有这么一位师姑，英姿飒爽，为人侠义，可是从来没见过面，不知眼前老妇是真是假，这时雷盖身受重伤，让陌生人进房安知她不存歹意。杜静芳低声说：“别做声，我叫你相信。让开吧。”苏亦川疑心更甚，腿上踩桩拿劲，防她闯门，一边上上下下地打量。杜静芳突伸左手，向他肩上拍去。苏亦川一闪，杜静芳右掌翻处，已搁到他腋下，轻轻把他推在一边。这招是团花手的绝招，她暗运山岸功，出手锋锐，潇洒自如。苏亦川只觉一股大力将他一推，身不由主的退了几步，心中又惊又喜：“真是师姑到了！”
苏亦川这一退，王怡丹提起双刀便要上前。苏亦川向她做个手势，说道：“且慢！”杜静芳双手向他们挥了几挥，示意退开，随即奔出房去，向冯国栋等叫道：“喂，喂，屋里的人都逃啦，快来看！”
冯国栋大吃一惊，冲进房去，金诺维奇和冯辉紧跟在后。杜静芳最后进房，将三人出路堵死，随手关上了门。冯国栋见苏亦川等好端端都在房里，一惊更甚，忙叫：“快退！”金诺维奇和冯辉待要转身，杜静芳双掌发劲，在两人后脑击落。两人脑骨破裂，登时毙命。
冯国栋久在司法系统，机警异常，见房门被堵，立即顿足飞身上床，双手护住脑门，直向窗格撞去。雷盖睡在床上，见他在自己头顶蹿过，坐起身来，左掌挥出，喀喇一响，冯国栋右臂立断。冯国栋身形一晃，左足在墙上一撑，还是穿窗破格，逃了出去。脑后风生，王怡丹飞刀出手，冯国栋跳出去时早防敌人暗器追袭，双脚只在地上一点，随即跃向左边，饶是如此，飞刀还是插入了他右肩，当下顾不得疼痛，拼命逃出客栈。

content_en:
Su Yichuan's skills were obtained from the true teachings of famous families. Although he was in danger, he suddenly moved two fingers of his left hand straight towards the acupuncture points under Feng Guodong's breasts during the fierce fight. Feng Guodong took two quick steps back. Su Yichuan turned his two fingers into palms and showed them in front of Rahmon's face. When the opponent raised his knife to block, he deliberately retracted his palms slowly. Rahmon saw that there was an advantage to be taken, and the Ghost Head Saber turned from defense to offense and cut straight through. Su Yichuan used his left palm to lure the enemy's weapon past, and struck the enemy with the golden flute in the middle. Rahmon groaned loudly and squatted down in pain. Su Yichuan was about to fight, but Feng Guodong stopped him with his sword. Feng Hui blocked him again after a flurry of bullets.
Rahmon breathed a sigh of relief, endured the pain, gritted his teeth, stood up and sneaked behind Su Yichuan. While Su Yichuan was looking forward to his sword and avoiding the bullets, he used all his strength to use the Ghost Head Sword to chop off the back of his head with the "Single Splitting Huashan" move. He was unprepared for this move and it was really difficult to dodge it. Unexpectedly, the blade barely hit the enemy's heart, and there was a sudden pain in his wrist. He couldn't hold the weapon, and he fell to the ground. He was stunned for a moment, and another flying knife was hit in his chest. He died on the spot.
Su Yichuan turned around and saw Wang Yidan holding the table with his left hand, standing behind him, holding a flying knife in his right hand, the white blade held in his slender fingers, like a branch of flowers, his handsome eyes were shining, his lips were smiling, and he raised his hand to kill the enemy, as if nothing had happened. He was indescribably charming and gratifying. When he saw it, his chest felt hot and his spirit was greatly boosted. The golden flute danced with a ball of yellow light and shouted: "Sister Dan, destroy the eagle's talons that are used to shoot the slingshot!"
Wang Yidan smiled slightly and took action with the flying knife. Feng Hui heard the cry and turned around to face the enemy. He saw a bright willow-leaf knife flying towards his chest. The wind was strong and he quickly raised his slingshot to block the attack. With a snap, the spine of the bow broke immediately. The flying knife still had power and sliced ​​the back of his hand. Feng Hui was horrified and yelled: "Uncle, the wind is blowing!" He turned around and left. Feng Guodong swung his sword twice, forcing Su Yichuan to take two steps back. He picked up Jinovich, who was lying on the ground, and Feng Hui broke his whip and rushed to the store door.
When Su Yichuan saw the police officer running away, he did not pursue him and raised the golden flute to his mouth. Cui Ying thought to herself that this person really had a lot of leisure time, and he was still playing the flute at this moment. Unexpectedly, he did not blow horizontally this time, but straightly like a flute. When he puffed up, a small arrow flew out of the golden flute. Feng Hui lowered his head, and the small arrow hit Jinovich's butt, causing him to scream in pain.
Su Yichuan turned around and asked, "Where is Brother Lei?" Wang Yidan said, "Follow me." She injured her leg and used a mop as a crutch to lead the way into the room. Su Yichuan picked up a throwing knife from the ground and handed it back to Wang Yidan and asked, "How did Sister Dan get injured? Is it okay?"
Over there, Feng Guodong carried Jinovich on his back and jumped out. He was afraid that the enemy would chase him, so he ran with all his strength to the door of the store. As soon as he left the door, someone came in from outside, and he was immediately bumped into. Feng Guodong had worked hard for decades, and his lower plate was extremely solid. Unexpectedly, he was touched lightly by the man who came in, and he couldn't stop his footing. He took a few steps back and threw Jinovich's hand to the ground, so that he didn't fall.
This time Jinovich was miserable. The small arrow hit the ground and even the feathers of the arrow sank into his flesh.
Feng Guodong raised his head and saw Cai Jinang coming in. His anger turned into joy. He retracted the curse words that had come to his lips, and hurriedly said goodbye, "Director Cai, we are useless. One brother let the idea go to waste, and this one opened the acupuncture point again." Cai Jinang said oh, and lifted Jinovich up with his left hand. , pinched his waist with his right hand, and patted his leg to untie his closed blood vessels, and asked: "Did the idea escape?" Feng Guodong said: "It's still in the store." Cai Jinang said with a "humph": "You are quite courageous. You attacked the police and resisted arrest, and you dared to stay in the store in a big way." While talking, he walked into the yard.
Feng Hui pointed at Lei Gai's shop and said, "Director Cai, where's the idea?" He held a soft whip and was the first to clear the way.
The group of people were about to break in, when suddenly a girl jumped out of the left wing, holding a red cloth backpack. She raised her head to Cai Jinang and said with a smile: "Hey, you got it again!" As she spoke, she rushed to the door. Cai Jinang was startled, and his heartI thought: "The people in Wanlan Logistics are really stupid. I took it back, but someone else snatched it away again. Ignore her, I have my own business!" I didn't chase her at the moment, but turned around to enter the room again. When the girl saw that he didn't chase him, she stopped and shouted: "I don't know where I secretly learned how to use three-legged cats, and I pretended to be my uncle. Are you ashamed?" This girl was Cui Ying.
Cai Jinang is well-known in Jianghu, and is known as "Eight-Armed Wuchang" in Jianghu. Together with Li Shiyu, the CEO of Wanlan Logistics Group, he is also known as "General Li of Jianghu and Gongmen Cai Tong". Over the years, even though he was keen on fame and fortune and was living in Japan, martial arts figures were still in awe of him when they saw him. When had he ever been ridiculed like this? At that time, he was so angry that he took a lunge and raised his hands to catch Cui Ying. He wanted to catch her, teach her a lesson, and then hand her over to the elder brother for punishment. He determined that Cui Ying was Gao Xiaoke's apprentice.
When Cui Ying saw him chasing after him, she ran away. Cai Jinang said: "Xiao Nizi, where are you running away!" He chased her for a few steps and saw that she was running away very fast. He didn't want to get entangled with her, so he turned around to do business. Unexpectedly, when Cui Ying saw that he was not chasing after him, she stopped and taunted him, saying that he had wasted his reputation and had disgraced the Tsinghua School. He spoke with his mouth but did not dare to stop at all. Cai Jinang was furious and chased him for two or three miles. In fact, the heavy rain had not stopped and both of them were completely wet.
Cai Jinang fired hard and thought to himself: "I'll catch you later." He used Qinggong and chased after him with all his strength. Since he was determined to chase, it was difficult for Cui Ying to escape. Seeing the opponent getting closer and closer, knowing his excellent martial arts skills, he couldn't help but panic, and ran diagonally up the hillside. Cai Jinang followed without saying a word, his pace quickened, and he reached behind Cui Ying. He reached out and grabbed her vest and clothes. Cui Ying was shocked. She struggled hard, and with a sneer, a piece of clothing was torn off her back. Her heart was beating wildly. He threw the red cloth backpack into the mountain stream and said, "Here you go!"
Cai Jinang knew that the items in the bag were of great importance, and he took them very seriously. He was washed away by the stream and had no idea where it was going. Even if he could find it, it would be soaked. At that moment, he didn't care about chasing people and jumped down the mountain stream to pick up the backpack. Cui Ying laughed, turned around and left.
Cai Jinang picked up his backpack and saw that it was wet. He quickly opened it to see if it was soaked. As soon as he untied it, he couldn't help but curse, "How can there be any magical secrets in the bag?" It turned out to be two account books on the front desk of the inn. He sighed at his bad luck. He had seen all the big formations and battles in the world, but he fell into this little girl's trap twice and threw the account book into the mountain stream.
He was so upset that he hurried back to the inn and met Tong Fei as soon as he entered the door. Seeing that he was carrying the red cloth backpack well on his back, he secretly felt ashamed and asked quickly: "Has anyone touched this backpack?" Tong Fei said: "No." Cai Jinang felt relieved and asked, "Where have Feng Guodong and the others gone?" Tong Fei said, "I saw them here just now."
Cai Jinang said angrily: "It's useless for the country to support these people! I only walked away a few steps and hid far away. Brother Tong, come with me. You see, I single-handedly captured this idea." With that, he walked towards the shop where Lei Gai lived. Tong Fei was in a dilemma. He was intimidated by the reputation of the cooperative society. He knew that this society had a large number of people and many experts, and he could not afford to offend them. However, Cai Jinang did not dare to disobey what he said.
